# Whitby Heating & Cooling

> Whitby Heating & Cooling is a local HVAC company serving Whitby, Durham Region, Ontario, offering furnace repair, AC repair, ductless mini-split installation, heat pump repair and installation, fireplace installation, thermostat repair, and duct cleaning to homeowners across the region.

Service areas: Whitby, Ajax, Pickering, Oshawa, Bowmanville, Newcastle, Courtice, Port Hope
